name: VRL Logistics Ltd
title: VRL Logistics Ltd - 539118 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Volume decline narrowing: Q4 tonnage up ~3% YoY after FY26 down ~7%, management guides 6-7% FY27 growth, but relies on fuel pass-through and a fleet adds plan of ~500 vehicles, not a capacity cut.

capex.quote: overall capital expenditure will be around INR300 crores for the full year

triggers.label: Q4 tonnage up ~3% YoY
triggers.quote: we are in a position to grow by around 3% in the volumes

triggers.label: Fuel surcharge and rate hikes passed through
triggers.quote: we are adding one line item in the contract that is the fuel surcharge

triggers.label: Vehicle fleet shrinking, hires up
triggers.quote: the vehicle capacity has been reduced compared to last year versus the Q4. For example, last year, we were at around 6,100

triggers.label: Bulk diesel procurement cut 41%→36%
triggers.quote: The quantity directly purchased from the refinery is reduced from 41% to 36%

guidance.value: 6% to 7% full year; at least 2% sequential growth per quarter
guidance.quote: we are expecting to grow at least around 6% to 7% for the full year basis
we are hoping that definitely, we can pass it on this cost to the customers and maintain the EBITDA margins in the range of around 20% plu s going forward
we are expecting around INR300 crores to INR350 crores capital expenditure
Net branches itself, we are expecting at least around 100 numbers in the coming year

red_flags.label: Fuel cost pass-through lag and bulk diesel loss
red_flags.quote: some basis points may impact on the margin because of this facility has been withdrawn

red_flags.label: Volume decline in plastic/petrochemical commodities
red_flags.quote: the demand of such product is coming down

evasions.quote: Because of the bulk information, we are unable to compute that information, but we are trying to do that.
Volume growth pressure is -- see, volume growth pressure is not on account of the increase in fuel rate.
